description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maliyadewapura, Thambuttegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110068
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their extent, ownership (primarily by the Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka), and various encumbrances or possession details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
